reference_vehicle.usage: Protocol geometry and test-condition evidence only; no manufacturer-specific CrashVector vehicle is implied.

test_condition.impact: small-overlap frontal impact into rigid barrier

published_observations.notes: Version VIII specifies 64.4 ± 1 km/h and 25 ± 1 percent overlap. CrashVector stores only the public protocol condition here; no IIHS rating, dummy injury measure, or intrusion outcome is used as a CrashVector acceptance corridor.

scope.required_model_gap: CrashVector has a generic rigid wall but does not yet implement and validate the IIHS 25-percent small-overlap barrier alignment/contact geometry as a production protocol target.
scope.warning: This reference records the IIHS test condition only. It does not mean CrashVector results are IIHS-correlated or suitable for ratings, injury prediction, or vehicle-specific safety assessment.
